Orchestrator builds its own URL via build_detail_url() so the new path is safe, but external consumers clicking the listing card hit the broken legacy URL. Should be a tightly-scoped fix task.

P2-3 (new): DB-first strategy in _get_or_fetch_departure_rows means once tour_departures has any row, the orchestrator never re-runs the HTTP fetch (Redis guard is only consulted on empty-DB branch). Stale rows can serve indefinitely between scheduled refreshes. Add a per-row refreshed_at TTL + scheduled refresher in the next package.

P2-4 (new, low): _should_trigger_detail_enrichment falls through to 'memory-locked + any non-trivial text triggers'. Once a tour is locked, almost any follow-up turn builds a planning bundle. DB-first keeps HTTP cost at zero on hot cycles, but per-turn parsing/matching cost is paid every time. Flag for post-wiring perf review.
